note: No definition could be quoted. The stored files are the bill's pages on the Chamber of Deputies site (official.html) and the Federal Senate site (secondary.html); they list the bill's procedural history, hearings and amendments, but do not contain the text of the bill. Amendment entries in the Senate page refer to the bill's definition of artificial intelligence systems and to items of its Article 4, so the bill does have definitions; not_found here means only that they are not in the stored files.
